abilities.name: Warp In Pylon
abilities.description: Warp in a Pylon that generates a Power Field and grants vision of the surrounding area. Probius only regenerates Mana while inside a Power Field. Enemy Heroes and Minions drop Minerals when killed. Gather Minerals to reduce the cooldown of Warp In Pylon by 0.75 seconds. Up to 2 Pylons can be active at a time. Pylon

fields.notes: Heroes drop minerals if Probius gets a Takedown regardless of distance.

abilities.name: Disruption Pulse
abilities.description: Fire a burst of energy forward, dealing 142 damage to all enemies it passes through. Hitting the center of a Warp Rift will cause it to explode, dealing additional damage.

fields.notes: Enemies cannot be hit by multiple Disruption Pulses too closely together, which can cause issues with multiple Probii on a team (e.g. an Abathur Ultimate Evolution Clone, or in ARAM), or even alone with the Shoot 'Em Up Talent.

abilities.name: Warp Rift
abilities.description: Charge Cooldown 6Open an unstable Warp Rift at a location that takes 1.25 seconds to arm, which then Slows nearby enemies by 25% lasting 3 seconds. Armed Warp Rifts explode when they expire or when hit by Disruption Pulse, dealing 261 damage to nearby enemies. Stores up to 2 charges.

fields.notes: A Warp Rift cannot be placed so that its center overlaps with a Structure, unpathable terrain, or another Warp Rift 's center. Warp Rifts provide vision within their radius.

abilities.name: Photon Cannon
abilities.description: Warp in a Photon Cannon that deals 105 damage. Lasts for 13 seconds. While within a Pylon's Power Field, Photon Cannons gain 40% Attack Speed over 4 seconds and reveal nearby enemies. Photon Cannon

fields.notes: Photon Cannon prefers to acquire Heroic targets. However, it will not change to a Heroic unit from a previously acquired target as long as it remains valid. Attack Speed ramps up by 2.5% of base every 0.25 seconds, to the maximum of 40% bonus Attack Speed.

abilities.name: Pylon Overcharge
abilities.description: For 8 seconds, increase the size of Pylon power fields and allow them to attack enemy Heroes within them for 96 damage per second. Pylons are Invulnerable for the duration.

abilities.name: Null Gate
abilities.description: Project a barrier of negative energy in the target direction that lasts 4 seconds. Enemies who touch the barrier take 76 damage per second and are Slowed by 80% for as long as they remain in contact with it.

fields.notes: First point of cast determines the location of the first end of the gate, and second the direction.

abilities.name: Worker Rush
abilities.description: Activate to gain an additional 60% Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Taking damage ends this effect early. Passive Probius moves 10% faster by hovering over the ground.

fields.notes: Movement Speed from Worker Rush stacks additively with other Movement Speed bonuses. Movement Speed bonus can be interrupted by damage over time ticks, even if applied before activating Worker Rush.

talents.name: Echo Pulse
talents.description: Disruption Pulse now returns to Probius 1.25 seconds after reaching its target, dealing 100% damage on the return trip.

fields.notes: Returning pulse has the same properties as initial pulse, it can detonate Warp Rifts and interacts with all Talents affecting Disruption Pulse. Damage reduction stacks additively with offensive damage modifiers that can affect Disruption Pulse 's damage.

_raw_fields: Disruption Pulse now returns to Probius 1.25 seconds after reaching its target, dealing 100% damage on the return trip.

talents.name: Warp Resonance
talents.description: Quest Hit Heroes with Warp Rift explosions. After hitting 8 Heroes with Warp Rift explosions, increase the explosion damage by 120. Reward After hitting 16 Heroes with Warp Rift explosions, Warp Rift gains 1 additional charge.
_raw_fields: Quest Hit Heroes with Warp Rift explosions. After hitting 8 Heroes with Warp Rift explosions, increase the explosion damage by 120. Reward After hitting 16 Heroes with Warp Rift explosions, Warp Rift gains 1 additional charge.

talents.name: Gather Minerals
talents.description: Quest Gather Minerals to increase the Health of Photon Cannons by 8, up to 560. After collecting 70 Minerals, Photon Cannons deal 35% more damage.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Photon Cannon 's damage.

_raw_fields: Quest Gather Minerals to increase the Health of Photon Cannons by 8, up to 560. After collecting 70 Minerals, Photon Cannons deal 35% more damage.

talents.name: Photon Barrier
talents.description: While a Photon Cannon is alive and powered, Probius gains 40 Spell Armor.

fields.notes: Does not stack with itself or other positive Spell Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

_raw_fields: While a Photon Cannon is alive and powered, Probius gains 40 Spell Armor.

talents.name: Turbo Charged
talents.description: Worker Rush grants an additional 10% passive Movement Speed while in a Power Field, and its cooldown is reduced by 14 seconds.
_raw_fields: Worker Rush grants an additional 10% passive Movement Speed while in a Power Field, and its cooldown is reduced by 14 seconds.

talents.name: Shield Capacitor
talents.description: Probius gains permanent Shields equal to 10% of his max Health. Shields regenerate quickly as long as he hasn't taken damage recently.
_raw_fields: Probius gains permanent Shields equal to 10% of his max Health. Shields regenerate quickly as long as he hasn't taken damage recently.

talents.name: Particle Accelerator
talents.description: After hitting 3 Heroes with Disruption Pulse the next Warp Rift detonated by a Disruption Pulse fires 4 additional pulses that deal 78 damage from the impact location in different directions. passive Reduce the cooldown of Disruption Pulse by 0.5 seconds.

fields.notes: Additional pulses are always fired relative to the direction from Probius's current location to the detonated Warp Rift. Pulses are aligned 30 degrees from the direction and perpendicular to it on both sides. Additional pulses can detonate Warp Rifts, but do not interact with Talents affecting Disruption Pulse, including itself.

_raw_fields: After hitting 3 Heroes with Disruption Pulse the next Warp Rift detonated by a Disruption Pulse fires 4 additional pulses that deal 78 damage from the impact location in different directions. passive Reduce the cooldown of Disruption Pulse by 0.5 seconds.

talents.name: Rift Shock
talents.description: Hitting a Warp Rift with Disruption Pulse within 1 second of its arming deals 105 damage over 3 seconds.
_raw_fields: Hitting a Warp Rift with Disruption Pulse within 1 second of its arming deals 105 damage over 3 seconds.

talents.name: Tower Defense
talents.description: Reduce Photon Cannon's cooldown by 3.5 seconds when Disruption Pulse or Warp Rift damages an enemy Hero.
_raw_fields: Reduce Photon Cannon's cooldown by 3.5 seconds when Disruption Pulse or Warp Rift damages an enemy Hero.

talents.name: Pylon Overcharge
talents.description: Cooldown 80 Increase the size of Pylon power fields and allow them to attack enemies within it for 96 damage per second. Lasts 10 seconds.
_raw_fields: Cooldown 80 Increase the size of Pylon power fields and allow them to attack enemies within it for 96 damage per second. Lasts 10 seconds.

talents.name: Null Gate
talents.description: Cooldown 25 Vector Targeting. Project a barrier of negative energy in the target direction that lasts 4 seconds. Enemies who touch the barrier take 76 damage per second and are slowed by 80% for as long as they remain in contact with it.
_raw_fields: Cooldown 25 Vector Targeting. Project a barrier of negative energy in the target direction that lasts 4 seconds. Enemies who touch the barrier take 76 damage per second and are slowed by 80% for as long as they remain in contact with it.

talents.name: Aggressive Matrix
talents.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 35% increased Basic Attack damage.

fields.notes: Damage bonus does not stack with itself, but stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect the targets' Basic Attack damage.

_raw_fields: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 35% increased Basic Attack damage.

talents.name: Power Overflowing
talents.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 10% increased Spell Power and 2 Mana per second.

fields.notes: Spell Power from Power Overflowing does not stack with itself, but stacks additively with other sources of Spell Power and other offensive damage and healing modifiers affecting targets' Spell Damage or healing output.

_raw_fields: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 10% increased Spell Power and 2 Mana per second.

talents.name: Shield Battery
talents.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 28 Shields per second, up to 112. Shields persist for 2 seconds after exiting a Pylon Power Field.

fields.notes: Shield gain starts after the Hero has been in a Pylon's area for 0.5 seconds.

_raw_fields: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 28 Shields per second, up to 112. Shields persist for 2 seconds after exiting a Pylon Power Field.

talents.name: Quantum Entanglement
talents.description: Enemies continue to be Slowed for 3 seconds after their last contact with a Warp Rift.
_raw_fields: Enemies continue to be Slowed for 3 seconds after their last contact with a Warp Rift.

talents.name: Gravity Well
talents.description: Enemies are Slowed more the closer they are to the center of the Warp Rift, up to a maximum Slow of 60%.

fields.notes: Applies 40% Slow within 2.0 radius and 60% Slow within 1.0 radius of the center.

_raw_fields: Enemies are Slowed more the closer they are to the center of the Warp Rift, up to a maximum Slow of 60%.

talents.name: Interference
talents.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Warp Rift detonations have their Spell Power reduced by 35% for 5 seconds. Additionally, enemies hit by Warp Rift explosions are knocked away from the center.

fields.notes: Spell Power reduction from Interference does not stack with itself, but stacks additively with other sources of Spell Power and other offensive damage and healing modifiers affecting targets' Spell Damage or healing output.

_raw_fields: Enemy Heroes hit by Warp Rift detonations have their Spell Power reduced by 35% for 5 seconds. Additionally, enemies hit by Warp Rift explosions are knocked away from the center.

talents.name: Construct Additional Pylons
talents.description: Probius can now have up to 3 active Pylons, and increase the damage of Pylon Overcharge by 25%.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Pylon Overcharge 's damage.

_raw_fields: Probius can now have up to 3 active Pylons, and increase the damage of Pylon Overcharge by 25%.

talents.name: Gate Keeper
talents.description: Null Gate lasts indefinitely if either end is within a Power Field.
_raw_fields: Null Gate lasts indefinitely if either end is within a Power Field.

talents.name: Shoot 'Em Up
talents.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Disruption Pulse take a bonus 2.5% of their maximum Health as damage. Passive Reduce the cooldown of Disruption Pulse by 0.5 seconds.
_raw_fields: Enemy Heroes hit by Disruption Pulse take a bonus 2.5% of their maximum Health as damage. Passive Reduce the cooldown of Disruption Pulse by 0.5 seconds.

talents.name: Probius Loop
talents.description: Whenever a Rift explosion hits 1 or more enemy Heroes, create a new Warp Rift in the same location.
_raw_fields: Whenever a Rift explosion hits 1 or more enemy Heroes, create a new Warp Rift in the same location.
